dataset: Source Finder Vol. 3 - Professional License Verification Directory for Agents - FREE SAMPLE
note: Free sample with entries for AR, CA, FL, TX, NY, WA, CO. Full version on Gumroad (bradray2): all 50 states + DC with cost, login, agent-access and portal-quirk notes for every entry.

entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in Arkansas for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: No central portal. This is the State Medical Board public verification page. Dept. of Labor and Licensing covers many other boards; nursing via healthy.arkansas.gov / Nursys.

entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in California for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: Central DCA License Search covering ~280 license types / ~3.9M licensees via BreEZe boards. NOT covered: Contractors (cslb.ca.gov) and Real Estate/DRE (dre.ca.gov).

entries.agency: Colorado DORA Division of Professions & Occupations
entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in Colorado for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: Central DORA lookup. Free, no login; has a case-sensitive entry code. Site asks crawlers not to scrape (CIM open-data API offered instead). Real Estate and insurance are separate.

entries.agency: Florida Dept. of Business & Professional Regulation
entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in Florida for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: Partial central: covers DBPR professions only. Health professions are separate (FL DOH MQA); Agriculture (FDACS) and Financial Services (DFS) are separate.

entries.agency: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions
entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in New York for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: No single central portal. NYSED verification search covers 50+ education-law professions. Split: Dept of State occupations at dos.ny.gov/licensee-search; DOH physician profiles at health.ny.gov.

entries.agency: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in Texas for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: TDLR License Search covers TDLR programs (active licenses, data refreshed daily). Health professions are NOT in it: Texas HHS TULIP public search at tulip.hhs.texas.gov/TULIP/s/public-search.

entries.answers: Is this person or business currently licensed in Washington for their profession, and what is the license status? Used for contractor, vendor, and hiring verification.
entries.notes: DOL lookup covers non-health professions (real estate, appraisers, architects, cosmetology, etc.). Health professions are NOT in it: separate DOH Provider Credential Search at fortress.wa.gov/doh/providercredentialsearch/.
